description: The proposed mission is part of a broader push to strengthen the state’s emerging technology ecosystem, attract investments, expand AI adoption and create new opportunities for startups and industry.
body_lead: Uttar Pradesh is preparing to launch its own Quantum Mission as it looks to strengthen its footprint in next-generation technologies and build a more competitive technology ecosystem, Alok Kumar, principal secretary, IT and Electronics, said at the ETGovernment AI Vision Conclave in Lucknow on Friday. The proposed mission will seek to build the state’s capabilities in the emerging field of quantum technology, signalling UP’s intent to participate in the next wave of technological innovation.
